cases.name: a-pool-lookup-reads-the-rearranged-uniq-member
cases.description: The first in-memory build looked the pool up by the value a <uniq> member drew, then rearranged the member: 4898 of 5000 rows printed a day that was not the one looked up. The lookup has to see the final value.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="gr" local="en" engine="1"><pool name="Days" count="4"><sequence name="di"><gen type="increment" value="1"/></sequence><sequence name="label"><gen type="text" value="mon,tue,wed,thu" order="sequential"/></sequence></pool><uniq><sequence name="A"><gen type="number" value="1..8"/></sequence><sequence name="B"><gen type="number" value="1..4"/></sequence></uniq><sequence name="Day"><gen type="pool" value="Days" filter="di == B"/></sequence><assert each="Day.di == B" says="the looked-up day is the drawn one"/></env><block><line><data>${{A}},${{B}},${{Day.di}},${{Day.label}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-formula-reads-the-rearranged-uniq-member
cases.description: Any column reading a <uniq> member, not only a pool lookup: a formula copied the value from before the rearrangement.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="gr" local="en" engine="1"><uniq><sequence name="A"><gen type="number" value="1..8"/></sequence><sequence name="B"><gen type="number" value="1..4"/></sequence></uniq><sequence name="F"><gen type="formula" expr="B * 10"/></sequence><assert each="F == B * 10" says="the formula reads the final B"/></env><block><line><data>${{A}},${{B}},${{F}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-reader-of-a-reader-sees-the-final-value
cases.description: A column reading a column that reads a <uniq> member: both have to be built after the rearrangement.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="gr" local="en" engine="1"><uniq><sequence name="A"><gen type="number" value="1..8"/></sequence><sequence name="B"><gen type="number" value="1..4"/></sequence></uniq><sequence name="F"><gen type="formula" expr="B + 1"/></sequence><sequence name="G"><gen type="formula" expr="F * 2"/></sequence><assert each="G == (B + 1) * 2" says="the chain reads the final B"/></env><block><line><data>${{B}},${{F}},${{G}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-formula-reads-the-repaired-distinct-member
cases.description: A <distinct> group repairs a row where two members collide; a formula reading the member had already copied the colliding value.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="gr" local="en" engine="1"><distinct><sequence name="A"><gen type="number" value="1..3"/></sequence><sequence name="B"><gen type="number" value="1..3"/></sequence></distinct><sequence name="F"><gen type="formula" expr="B + 0"/></sequence><assert each="F == B" says="the formula reads the repaired B"/><assert each="A != B" says="the group still holds"/></env><block><line><data>${{A}},${{B}},${{F}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-pool-lookup-reads-the-repaired-distinct-member
cases.description: The same for a pool lookup filtered on a <distinct> member.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="gr" local="en" engine="1"><pool name="Days" count="4"><sequence name="di"><gen type="increment" value="1"/></sequence><sequence name="label"><gen type="text" value="mon,tue,wed,thu" order="sequential"/></sequence></pool><distinct><sequence name="A"><gen type="number" value="1..3"/></sequence><sequence name="B"><gen type="number" value="1..3"/></sequence></distinct><sequence name="Day"><gen type="pool" value="Days" filter="di == B"/></sequence><assert each="Day.di == B" says="the looked-up day is the repaired one"/></env><block><line><data>${{A}},${{B}},${{Day.di}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-uniq-group-inside-a-pool-and-a-field-reading-it
cases.description: A pool builds its members the way an env builds rows, so a field of the pool reading a member of the pool's own <uniq> group has the same order to get right.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="gr" local="en" engine="1"><pool name="P" count="8"><uniq><sequence name="A"><gen type="number" value="1..8"/></sequence><sequence name="B"><gen type="number" value="1..4"/></sequence></uniq><sequence name="F"><gen type="formula" expr="B * 10"/></sequence></pool><sequence name="R"><gen type="pool" value="P"/></sequence><assert each="R.F == R.B * 10" says="the pool field reads the final B"/></env><block><line><data>${{R.A}},${{R.B}},${{R.F}}</data></line></block></tdc>
